fieldValues.title: Writer in Evidence-backed writing
fieldValues.summary: The one writer building carefully argued essays in their own words, where every claim can stand up to critical argument, directing a few agents that respond and never write. The first case is the owner, writing essays about muDemocracy with a reference library already built; in another context a writer must build that library too.
goals: Every claim is valid and can withstand critical argument
The text stays in the writer's own words, with no agent drafting
Abandoned framings are kept as attempts to review later
Start from a blank page, an article being answered or a transcript
Work on several essays at once, see their state and publish them
Hold a manageable conversation with agents: ask for input when wanted, and not otherwise
jobs: Lay out a claim with its premises
Link claims to problems, quotes and evidence in the research base
Check each claim against the evidence
Hear the red team challenge a claim and the blue team back it
Turn a news article or a transcript into quotable evidence
Restructure an argument without losing links or abandoned framings
Organise essays like files: folders, moving essays, a bin that can be cleared
See which essays share a paragraph, and edit it without changing another essay by accident
Tell the agents they direct (claude.ai, ChatGPT or a defined agent) their context and focus
Keep a set of agent briefs with a document as standard instructions
fieldValues.needs: Structure that survives editing, claims checkable against evidence, agent responses that never write the text, and abandoned framings kept rather than lost.
